answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 355 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the vault challenge, the grove audit can replay the canyon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 112 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
